lines.say: Your memories were only rented. The lease ends on Friday.
A letter from MemCo. Childhood memories, leased since you were five.
Wednesday, the first one goes. Your mom's face. Then her voice.
You pay. Everything comes back. Except one box, still locked.
You open the file. The lease was signed by you. At nine. To forget something.
What would you pay to keep one memory? Write it in the comments.
